resourceInspector.title: Hardware resources
resourceInspector.subtitle: Read-only view of resource relationships, current bindings, and evidence coverage

conflictDefaults.reason: Two structured requests point to the same resource.
conflictDefaults.impact: The affected hardware function may behave unexpectedly.
conflictDefaults.suggestion: Review the related blocks and their resource claims.

compiler-observation-stale.reason: The project or target changed. The previous compiler-based implementation observation is no longer being used.
compiler-observation-stale.impact: Declared resource checks remain available, but do not confirm every library's current resource use.
compiler-observation-stale.suggestion: Build again to inspect the library and Core implementations selected for the current project.

interrupt-latency-risk.reason: One selected implementation needs timely interrupts; another masks interrupts or occupies an interrupt handler. This does not necessarily mean they use the same timer.
interrupt-latency-risk.impact: Concurrent operation may cause pulse jitter or communication timing errors. Source evidence identifies a potential risk, not a hardware-tested failure.
interrupt-latency-risk.suggestion: Locate the related blocks and review the selected implementations, communication rate and timing requirements. Verify on hardware. CK will not change libraries, pins or the project automatically.

exclusive-conflict.reason: Two functions request the same exclusive resource.
exclusive-conflict.impact: One or both hardware functions may behave unexpectedly.
exclusive-conflict.suggestion: Review the related blocks and choose a compatible resource arrangement.

reserved-resource.reason: The resource is reserved by the board or runtime.
reserved-resource.impact: The requested function may not be available on this target.
reserved-resource.suggestion: Review the related blocks and the board resource notes.

route-conflict.reason: Two requests require incompatible routes for the same signal.
route-conflict.impact: One route may not be applied to the requested pin or peripheral.
route-conflict.suggestion: Review the related blocks and select a compatible route.

discriminator-conflict.reason: Two requests use the same address or selector value.
discriminator-conflict.impact: The device or peripheral may not be distinguishable at runtime.
discriminator-conflict.suggestion: Review the related blocks and the address or selector values.

configuration-conflict.reason: The requested resource settings cannot be combined.
configuration-conflict.impact: The affected peripheral may not initialize with these settings.
configuration-conflict.suggestion: Review the related blocks and align their configuration values.

resourceInspector.noConflictDetail: No recorded resource conflicts. No conflict does not mean guaranteed safe.

implementationHelp.needs-compile: Declared resource checks update while editing. A successful build is required to inspect the actual selected implementations.
implementationHelp.running: The build has succeeded. CK is collecting implementation evidence in the background; you can continue editing.
implementationHelp.partial: Recognized implementation results are included below. Unrecognized calls and runtime behavior remain unresolved; this is not a physical hardware test.
implementationHelp.unavailable: CK could not obtain usable implementation evidence. Declared checks remain available where supported; this does not mean no conflicts exist.
implementationHelp.stale: The project or target changed. Previous implementation results are no longer current. Build again to update them.

implementationUsage.title: Resources observed in selected implementations
implementationUsage.description: These rows come from verified compiler traces for the successful build. They describe observed source usage, not hardware validation or a guarantee that every call was recognized.

resourcePreflight.implementationScope: Current automatic recognition covers reviewed Arduino AVR Core 1.8.8 implementations and the AVR implementation of Servo 1.3.0. Other implementations may only have declared checks. Unknown does not mean conflict-free. CK never changes pins, libraries or the project automatically.

growth.title: Resource changes

summary.incomparable: Capacity configuration changed; growth cannot be compared

detail.verified: Each source below is checked against content-hashed linker/section evidence, and the allocation reconciles exactly with the compiler total.
detail.total-only: This build has no verifiable linker map or section report. Only the total change is known; it cannot be attributed to a library, font, or block.
detail.no-baseline: Build the same project with the complete FQBN successfully once more to compare total Flash/RAM changes.
detail.incomparable: The APP partition or RAM limit changed. CK rebuilt the baseline instead of misreporting a capacity change as code growth.
detail.rejected: Source attribution failed consistency checks and was rejected; the compiler total is still shown.

growth.linkerOverhead: Link layout, alignment, and ungrouped sections
